name: SGP4-XP propagator and fitter (US Space Force Sgp4Prop)
description: The US Space Force SGP4 and SGP4-XP (Astro Standards v9.1 Sgp4Prop WebAssembly 9.1.1.0, XP build) as a space data module, and SDN's own SGP4-XP element sets fitted to ephemerides. propagate takes $OCM element sets (MEAN_ELEMENTS of theory SGP4XP, BTERM and AGOM typed, under the theory's own forces: ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL {JXX,1970}, WEATHER_SOURCE THEORY_FLUX_MODEL, DENSITY_CORRECTION NONE, both gravity caps 0; SGP4 sets too, under WEATHER_SOURCE NONE) to $OEM trajectories on the grid an optional $OEM template names, in TEME or GCRF. fit takes an $OEM ephemeris, TEME, GCRF (ICRF, J2000, EME2000) or Earth-fixed, UTC, GPS, TAI or TT, and returns one $OCM: the SGP4XP element set that fits its declared interval, the theory's own forces stated (GRAVITY_MODEL EGM-96), ORBIT_DETERMINATION with FIT_STATISTICS (the fit and the held-out states, by day), and PROVENANCE naming the library. ingest_omm is the $OMM boundary: SGP4XP $OMM records (BTERM in BSTAR, AGOM in MEAN_MOTION_DDOT) to $OCM, and into the table the propagator ABI exports (plugin_init_omm, plugin_propagate, plugin_propagate_batch, plugin_destroy) propagate; those are the exports of propagator/keplerian-reference, in Earth-fixed metres, so OrbPro's pluggable propagation and the maneuver detector's propagator query port route to it, and every ABI record flies as a stock SGP4-XP set. The library is the Space Force's, as released, joined to the SDN code in the one module.wasm by wasm-merge; it reads two-line element text, so every set has the digits of that text. Distributed under the US Space Force Open Source Agreement for SGP4 (third_party/ussf-sgp4/AGREEMENT.txt); the US Space Force does not endorse this module.
tagline: SGP4 and SGP4-XP from the US Space Force's library, and SGP4-XP element sets fitted to any ephemeris.

sequentialJustification.detail: Propagation is embarrassingly parallel across element sets and strictly sequential within one, and a fit is a sequence of dependent propagations: each iteration needs the last. The propagator ABI puts sharding on the host (docs/propagator-abi.md, Threading), so this module spawns no threads of its own and shares nothing between rows; the Space Force library inside it is single-threaded.

methods.description: The $OMM boundary: each SGP4XP $OMM (a Space-Track or CelesTrak set: BTERM in BSTAR, AGOM in MEAN_MOTION_DDOT, m**2/kg) becomes one $OCM on 'ocm' with the theory's own forces written explicitly (ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL {JXX,1970}, WEATHER_SOURCE THEORY_FLUX_MODEL, DENSITY_CORRECTION NONE, both caps 0, GRAVITY_MODEL EGM-96, ORB_AVERAGING BROUWER), NORAD_CAT_ID, the identity, ORIGINATOR and the $OMM's PROVENANCE; the sets also replace the module's element table, which the propagator ABI exports (plugin_propagate, plugin_propagate_batch) propagate. Handles are the order the records arrive in. Refused by name: missing-omm, invalid-omm, unsupported-center, user-defined-parameters:<count> (an $OMM with USER_DEFINED_PARAMETERS, by their count, never read by name), theory-not-ingestable:AP, unsupported-theory (any theory but SGP4XP: the ABI is this module's SGP4-XP), element-set-refused.

inputPorts.description: $OMM SGP4XP element sets (BTERM in BSTAR, AGOM in MEAN_MOTION_DDOT), each a plain buffer or size-prefixed buffers one after another.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Ratified SDS $OMM mean elements. The module decodes the FlatBuffer itself; there is no wildcard.

outputPorts.description: One size-prefixed $OCM per 'omm' record, in order.

methods.description: Each $OCM element set to one $OEM: a block per grid block on the optional grid port, TEME (TEMEOFDATE) or GCRF, km and km/s, UTC. A set is MEAN_ELEMENTS of theory SGP4XP (BTERM, AGOM) or SGP4 (BSTAR, MEAN_MOTION_DOT, MEAN_MOTION_DDOT) under that theory's own forces, TEMEOFDATE, centered on the Earth; the theory is read from MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY alone and the mean motion is the record's. A grid block names START_TIME, STOP_TIME and STEP_SIZE (default: the set's epoch, a day later, 60 s), or lists the epochs it wants as EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES (EPOCH only); its REFERENCE_FRAME picks the axes (default TEME). The set's elements are rounded to the digits of the two-line text the Space Force library reads. Refused by name: missing-ocm, invalid-ocm, omm-not-flown (an $OMM enters through ingest_omm), mean-elements-missing, mean-element-theory-unspecified, theory-not-flown:<THEORY> (AP, or any theory but SGP4XP and SGP4; UNKNOWN when it has no name), elements-other-theory, orb-averaging-mismatch, weather-source-not-stock (a WEATHER_SOURCE other than the theory's own, or space-weather rows or density-correction nodes), atmosphere-not-stock, gravity-terms-not-stock, frame-pairing-invalid, unsupported-center, invalid-grid, element-set-refused, propagation-failed, too-many-states.

inputPorts.description: $OCM element sets to propagate, in the order their trajectories are returned; each a plain buffer or size-prefixed buffers one after another.
Optional $OEM template: the epochs and axes of the trajectories. Its states, if any, are ignored.

outputPorts.description: One $OEM per element set, one block per grid block: EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES in km and km/s, UTC, centred on the Earth.

methods.displayName: Fit SGP4-XP elements to an OEM ephemeris
methods.description: Fits the six mean elements, BTERM and AGOM to each ephemeris block (Levenberg-Marquardt on TEME position residuals, then a search of the lattice of the two-line text's digits) and returns the set whose epoch is the first state of the declared fit interval. The fit interval is the block's USEABLE_START_TIME to USEABLE_STOP_TIME (the whole block when neither is stated); the states after USEABLE_STOP_TIME up to STOP_TIME are held out and scored, overall and by day after the fit interval. The $OCM carries the set (MEAN_ELEMENTS, theory SGP4XP), the theory's own forces (ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL {JXX,1970}, WEATHER_SOURCE THEORY_FLUX_MODEL, no space-weather rows, DENSITY_CORRECTION NONE, both caps 0, GRAVITY_MODEL EGM-96), HEADER.ORIGINATOR the source's (the $OEM's), METADATA.NORAD_CAT_ID, ORBIT_DETERMINATION (OD_ESTIMATOR BatchLeastSquares, OD_EPOCH, ACTUAL_OD_SPAN, BTERM and AGOM as OD_DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS) with FIT_STATISTICS (FIT_START, FIT_STOP, the fit's states, RMS, maximum and radial, in-track and cross-track RMS in km, the iterations, convergence, and the held-out stop, states, RMS, maximum and days), and PROVENANCE (PRODUCER: this module over the US Space Force Sgp4Prop 9.1.1.0). Frames TEME, GCRF (ICRF, J2000, J2000A, EME2000) and Earth-fixed (ITRF, ECEF, WGS84), time systems UTC, GPS, TAI and TT; positions suffice (the first velocity is derived by Gibbs' method). Refused by name: invalid-oem, unsupported-frame, unsupported-center, bad-epoch, no-states, too-few-states, arc-too-short, leap-second-in-arc, fit-failed.

inputPorts.description: $OEM ephemerides, one fit per data block. Compact (EPHEMERIS_DATA with STEP_SIZE; STATE_VECTOR_SIZE 3, 6 or 9) or verbose (EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES).
Optional $EOP rows (UT1-UTC, pole, celestial pole offsets), used only to rotate Earth-fixed ephemerides; without them UT1 = UTC and the pole is at its mean position.

outputPorts.description: One size-prefixed $OCM SGP4XP element set per block, in block order, with its orbit determination and FIT_STATISTICS.
